summary_text: 2025-07-14T11:21:34+00:00: NetWitness generated a High severity alert for host BETHANYCHUCHU (Windows) after vmtoolsd.exe, running as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM, made outbound HTTPS connections associated with external IOC 4.145.79.81 and destination 124.155.222.24. The endpoint telemetry also recorded additional suspicious process activity on the same host, including cmd.exe, sc.exe, reg.exe, and wmiprvse.exe artifacts. Triage data linked the event to lateral movement across internal RFC1918 ranges 192.168.10.x and 192.168.20.x, and the alert title indicated lateral movement plus UAC disabling behavior. Process lineage evidence showed cmd.exe invoking reg.exe to modify HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\EnableLUA=0, indicating UAC weakening/privilege-escalation preparation. Service-control and WMI-related artifacts suggest remote execution or service abuse on BETHANYCHUCHU. No clear evidence of data theft or confirmed malware payload execution was present in the provided telemetry, but the event set is consistent with hostile administrative activity and lateral movement attempts.
